{{Top|leg}}
'''Progress Plaza''' was a large public plaze in [[Calimondretta]], the main city on the planet [[Syned]] which was the icy capital of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state known as the [[Arkadianate]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] and the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] leader [[Jarrow Rusher]] visited Progress Plaza during a tour organized by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Arkadia Calimondra]], the Arkadianate's ruler. Progress Plaza was presumably damaged during the [[Siege of Calimondretta]].
